# Cross-plugin layout test source

floating-layout.mjs is an exact test-only copy of Emikosama/mate-watch installer/floating-layout.mjs at commit 20f20225da2b7af7a4b7bc295cda116569983a19. It preserves docked pairs while dragging either member.

Source: https://github.com/Emikosama/mate-watch/blob/20f20225da2b7af7a4b7bc295cda116569983a19/installer/floating-layout.mjs

SHA-256: 2d01aafffac2482ce2980bb3f4b095f79d98e8da13220acecbacfbb53f87f65b

It is not included in the shipped voice bundle. Production voice optionally consumes the version 1 Cordis whaleFloatingLayout service supplied by the watch plugin.
